⚙️ Settings
GST Registration Status
Filled in automatically from your first Tax Invoice. Bills dated before this belong to the pre-GST period. CA reports (GST Summary, Sales export with "GST bills only", P&L "GST era") start here.
📦 Delivery message prompts on this device
Turn OFF on the laptop you import tracking on, and leave ON on your phone. The laptop then only tells you how many messages are waiting, and the phone pops them up after its next sync. Saved on this device only.
🔗 Linked Stock
Linked products share one physical stock pool. If a sale needs more articles than the invoiced product holds, the extra is now taken automatically from its linked articles (lowest product number first). Deleting or returning the invoice puts every article back where it came from.
Sign up free at calendarific.com → Dashboard → API Key. Needed for automatic festival date detection.
📖 Catalogue Settings
Saved once, on this device only — partner numbers are never written to the Settings sheet. The Partner Report modal shows one Send button per number you fill in.
Create at github.com/settings/tokens → Classic → repo scope. Photos upload to your vismaadcreations/vismaad repo.
Create a new blank public Google Sheet → share as Viewer → copy ID from URL. App writes product data here for the live catalogue page.
📦 Courier Tracking (Track123)
Used to auto-track DTDC and Blue Dart shipments. India Post is unaffected. Sign up free at track123.com → Developers → API Key. Free plan: 50 shipments/month per account.
Sign up at track123.com → Developers → API to get your key.
Create a second account to get 50 more free trackings/month. App switches to this key automatically when Key 1 hits its limit.

📝 Issue Credit Note
What is a Credit Note?
A Credit Note reduces the value of a previously issued bill/invoice. Use it when:
• Customer returned goods (full or partial)
• You overcharged and want to issue a refund
• Order was cancelled after billing
• Quality issue — partial credit given

The original document stays unchanged. The credit note references it and reduces the outstanding amount.
